notes.title: V0.54 Update Released!
notes.content:
The V0.54 update has been released! 

Changelist:
- “Burger Time” can now be activated with the X button (gamepad) or middle mouse button. When this mode is activated, time slows down, giving you leeway to aim or plan your next move. Use this mode strategically or when you’re in a pinch! The Burger Time gauge (displayed in the center of the screen) depletes while Burger Time is active. The gauge will regenerate over time, as well as upon successful combo hits.
- New Drill Potato model! (new combat AI, effects, and other adjustments are planned for later)
- Updated Unreal Engine version from 5.1.1 to 5.2.1. The default graphics options were adjusted for a 60fps target framerate, so I recommend resetting the game graphics settings to default and readjusting as appropriate (framerate display can be enabled from the “advanced” tab of the options menu)
- Overhauled Orbit Mode controls to improve precision and responsiveness. Should no longer feel “floaty”, especially when controlling with the mouse.
- Fixed a lot of physics and geometry-related issues.
- New and updated sound effects and music!
- Various other adjustments and minor fixes!

Planning to add new gameplay content in the next patch (late September target)!

Join the BURGER IMPACT Discord server here: https://discord.gg/AhPjRfSJ4W 
Follow on Twitter here: https://twitter.com/neofuturelabs 

Thanks!

notes.title: V0.53 Update Released!
notes.content:
Hey all,

The V0.53 update has been released! It took a while to implement, but BURGER IMPACT now has an “Intelligent Chain Targeting System”!!! 

Simply aiming while in Orbit Mode will automatically string together a chain of targets that will be knocked in succession. Furthermore, a damage boost will increase as the chain progresses, allowing for longer chains to deal mega destruction!

Now I need to create new content that makes the most out of this system...

Changelist:
- New “Intelligent Chain Targeting System” and chain damage bonus system
- New “TRAINING AREA 1” stage added to FREE PLAY mode
- Various new sound effects
- Physics adjustments
- Other minor adjustments

Join the BURGER IMPACT Discord server here: https://discord.gg/AhPjRfSJ4W 
Follow on Twitter here: https://twitter.com/neofuturelabs 

Thanks!!

notes.title: V0.52 Update Released!
notes.content:
Hey, it’s NEO FUTURE LABS!

The V0.52 update has been released! I’ve updated the visuals and lighting of every stage in the game. The main goal was to increase contrast and make it easier to distinguish between the player, environment, and dynamic objects. This should result in increased readability for the screen, and overall improved visual quality. The gameplay videos and screenshots on the Store Page have been updated accordingly. Let me know what you think in the comments!

- Added new HUD reticle for clearer targeting
- Speed line effect color now varies on a per-stage basis & brightness adjustment for visibility
- Added texture to black ball objects for better visibility against dark backgrounds (note: model isn’t final)
- Space Ketchup no longer spawns from enemies in POTATO ATTACK Survival Stage to improve visual clarity
- Overall sound effect and volume adjustments. Fixed issue where consecutive collisions wouldn’t trigger sound effects in some cases. (note: many sound effects are still temporary or have adjustments planned)
- Other minor adjustments, visual adjustments, object placement adjustments

There is now a Discord Server! You can use the link below to join the BURGER IMPACT community and keep up with or participate in the game’s ongoing development!

notes.title: More minor adjustments patch (still V0.51)
notes.content:
Various minor adjustments.

Changelist:
- Increased Orbit Mode magnet maximum movement speed according to distance from Orbit Target
- Increased maximum targeting distance for Orbit Mode and line simulation
- Add homing so that player is less likely to miss Orbit Target when launching (homing only triggers when the player is within set distance of the Orbit Target)
- Added supplemental explanation popups to the tutorial stages (might have overdone it!). Will remove them later when they are no longer necessary. Also removed the obstacles from the first tutorial stage for the time being.
- Increased Drill Potato enemy size.
- Fixed issue where Drill Potato would sometimes spin out of control and become unable to reorient.
- Increased knockback against Drill Potato (still needs more adjustment later)
- Other minor fixes and adjustments

notes.title: Adjustment Update V0.51 Released!
notes.content:
The V0.51 Adjustment Update has been released!
You can confirm the current version from the Title Screen.

Changelist:
- Adjusted Burger model + gave Burger a bandana (temporary model). The bandana changes colors to indicate Burger’s health!
- Added damage numbers! This will make it easier to determine how effective your attacks are.
- Increased player charge launch speed by about 40% and Orbit Mode attraction speed by 50%. These changes result in an overall faster tempo.
- Greatly increased targeting zone. This massively reduces the amount of precision necessary for targeting an object to enter Orbit Mode, and should result in smoother gameplay.
- Added countermeasures to make it harder to miss an object when launching from close Orbit.
- Reduced default gamepad stick sensitivity by about 20% based on user feedback. You can also adjust the stick sensitivity from the Options menu.
- Other minor fixes and adjustments

notes.title: BURGER IMPACT: SOLAR STRIKE has been released into Steam Early Access! (V0.50)
notes.content:
BURGER IMPACT is now available for purchase via Steam Early Access!

As Burger, engage in the original "space-billiards realtime combat system!" and go on an adventure to rescue your friend French Fries and save the galaxy!

The current version has the following game modes available:
- STORY MODE (Tutorial + Story levels!)  * Content is currently on the light side / under development!
- ARCADE MODE (Aim for high scores in SURVIVAL, SCORE ATTACK, and TIME ATTACK stages!)
- FREE PLAY MODE (Play freely on original stages!)

BURGER IMPACT is under active development, so feedback and suggestions are appreciated. Feel free to post on the Steam Discussions forum!
If you would prefer to wait for the full version, please add BURGER IMPACT to your Steam Wishlist!
